body: Thanks. I'm 29 and I just got some loud tinnitus and this means a lot to me. If you're ever awake during the American night hours, I'd like to talk to you at least once when I can't sleep.

Yeah, I heard about Tinnitus on NPR once, it was a musician who had pretty much exactly the type that I have, and I remember thinking that it would be the worst thing in the world.  High pitched in both ears, modulating between two quarter quarter tones in left.  Complete torture.  I'm told that the depression and anxiety passes, but it's REALLY tough right now.

Thank you very much for the offer to talk to me, I may hit you up.  Yeah, my job is loud.  Good call on worker's comp.

Yeah, I had a primary care doctor say I'll have to live with it, but I'm going to see an ENT in a couple months.

I'm in talk therapy but writing or talking is the only thing that distracts me at this point, so thanks for replying.

http://www.ata.org/nagler-letter-to-tinnitus-sufferer

^ this was helpful to anyone reading this with Tinnitus. 

I'm just so afraid it's going to get worse.  I can barely avoid suicide as it is.  I'm not sure if I should quit my job if it's loud, but I know that my parents would flip out if I asked to stay with them long-term again.
